text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein says freedom has no ceiling, but it has limits which forbid violation and harm. There will be no revoking of the press law. When we reach the required level of consciousness we will not need laws or organisations, king says.
- Government to float prices for fizzy drinks.
- Gulf Arab investors seek a stake in Housing Bank .
- Politicians question result of opinion poll which criticised parliament's performance.
